description:
Residual surface outside this PRD's deliberate scope: the shipped three-line rule leaves non-local named variants such as .env.production and .env.staging committable (reviewer-verified in a tmpdir: only .env, .env.local and .env.*.local match). The chosen shape mirrors the repo's own root .gitignore (lines 21-26) and the standard dotenv convention, and the PRD notes explicitly scoped out broadening it, so this is a follow-up candidate rather than a defect in the delivered story: a user who puts real tokens in .env.production is still exposed to the same autonomous-agent commit path the story exists to close.
